name: @sheetwrite/docs-solid
description: Prototype: three docs pages on TanStack Start with Solid, to compare with the React docs site.

scripts.build:full: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && bunx pagefind --site dist/client
scripts.build:islands: DOCS_SOLID_ISLANDS=1 node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.islands.config.ts && bun src/islands/page-scripts.ts && bunx pagefind --site dist/client
